title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, possibly Eastern Azerbaijan
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, possibly Eastern Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul. inv. no 110 (3950) from Cerablus, Turkey. 250 x 569 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 96. A textile found with the carpet is ascribed as having been donated to the Great Mosque at Bitlis.
